answer: Random peer audit stops fakes. Each identity locks a bond of 2x 30-day earnings for 20 epochs. Each epoch a beacon audits 5%, and three peers re-check work at a summit review. A nebula of accounts looks large, but each must show past work. A prism test splits one history into tasks, so copied work fails one part. Mismatch burns the bond. Faking 100 identities costs 100 bonds, 6,000 days. An honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted rewards.
